## 2026.6.35

This is the final June 2026 Extended Stable (LTS) release.

### Highlights

- **Safer provider and channel boundaries:** bundled providers and channel adapters now bound untrusted response bodies, reject oversized inputs before expensive work, and preserve safe recovery when transports fail. (#119942) Thanks @RomneyDa, @vincentkoc, @Pick-cat, @RileyJJY, @ZengWen-DT, @Monkey-wusky, @chengzhichao-xydt, @mushuiyu886, @masatohoshino, @moguangyu5-design, @sunlit-deng, @ZOOWH, @NianJiuZst, @Alix-007, @aniruddhaadak80, @eleqtrizit, @yetval, @rvdlaar, @litang9, @machine3at, @miorbnli, @sallyom, @obviyus, @hugenshen, @cursoragent, @cxbAsDev, @wangmiao0668000666, @lsr911, and @jalfaro2876.
- **More reliable long-running delivery:** agent, gateway, retry, and channel paths now handle cancellation, retries, partial sends, and process-stream failures without losing work or replaying unsafe operations. (#119942) Thanks @RomneyDa, @vincentkoc, @Pick-cat, @RileyJJY, @ZengWen-DT, @Monkey-wusky, @chengzhichao-xydt, @mushuiyu886, @masatohoshino, @moguangyu5-design, @sunlit-deng, @ZOOWH, @NianJiuZst, @Alix-007, @aniruddhaadak80, @eleqtrizit, @yetval, @rvdlaar, @litang9, @machine3at, @miorbnli, @sallyom, @obviyus, @hugenshen, @cursoragent, @cxbAsDev, @wangmiao0668000666, @lsr911, and @jalfaro2876.
- **Stronger bundled-plugin resilience:** local-model, browser, media, and collaboration plugins recover cleanly from malformed payloads, timeouts, and transient upstream failures. (#119942) Thanks @RomneyDa, @vincentkoc, @Pick-cat, @RileyJJY, @ZengWen-DT, @Monkey-wusky, @chengzhichao-xydt, @mushuiyu886, @masatohoshino, @moguangyu5-design, @sunlit-deng, @ZOOWH, @NianJiuZst, @Alix-007, @aniruddhaadak80, @eleqtrizit, @yetval, @rvdlaar, @litang9, @machine3at, @miorbnli, @sallyom, @obviyus, @hugenshen, @cursoragent, @cxbAsDev, @wangmiao0668000666, @lsr911, and @jalfaro2876.
- **Safer tool and workspace use:** browser automation, local tools, workspace reads, and plugin metadata handling now reject malformed or oversized inputs before they can interrupt an active agent run. (#119942) Thanks @RomneyDa, @vincentkoc, @Pick-cat, @RileyJJY, @ZengWen-DT, @Monkey-wusky, @chengzhichao-xydt, @mushuiyu886, @masatohoshino, @moguangyu5-design, @sunlit-deng, @ZOOWH, @NianJiuZst, @Alix-007, @aniruddhaadak80, @eleqtrizit, @yetval, @rvdlaar, @litang9, @machine3at, @miorbnli, @sallyom, @obviyus, @hugenshen, @cursoragent, @cxbAsDev, @wangmiao0668000666, @lsr911, and @jalfaro2876.
- **More dependable local integrations:** local-model discovery, speech, meeting, and collaboration integrations now make bounded requests and surface failures without destabilizing the gateway. (#119942) Thanks @RomneyDa, @vincentkoc, @Pick-cat, @RileyJJY, @ZengWen-DT, @Monkey-wusky, @chengzhichao-xydt, @mushuiyu886, @masatohoshino, @moguangyu5-design, @sunlit-deng, @ZOOWH, @NianJiuZst, @Alix-007, @aniruddhaadak80, @eleqtrizit, @yetval, @rvdlaar, @litang9, @machine3at, @miorbnli, @sallyom, @obviyus, @hugenshen, @cursoragent, @cxbAsDev, @wangmiao0668000666, @lsr911, and @jalfaro2876.

### Changes

- **Extended-stable maintenance:** this release carries the audited reliability and security backports selected for the `extended-stable` line, without introducing a new release-line feature. (#119942) Thanks @RomneyDa, @vincentkoc, @Pick-cat, @RileyJJY, @ZengWen-DT, @Monkey-wusky, @chengzhichao-xydt, @mushuiyu886, @masatohoshino, @moguangyu5-design, @sunlit-deng, @ZOOWH, @NianJiuZst, @Alix-007, @aniruddhaadak80, @eleqtrizit, @yetval, @rvdlaar, @litang9, @machine3at, @miorbnli, @sallyom, @obviyus, @hugenshen, @cursoragent, @cxbAsDev, @wangmiao0668000666, @lsr911, and @jalfaro2876.

### Fixes

- **Response and memory safety:** provider, search, embedding, media, and channel integrations cap successful and error response reads before hostile payloads can exhaust process memory. (#119942) Thanks @RomneyDa, @vincentkoc, @Pick-cat, @RileyJJY, @ZengWen-DT, @Monkey-wusky, @chengzhichao-xydt, @mushuiyu886, @masatohoshino, @moguangyu5-design, @sunlit-deng, @ZOOWH, @NianJiuZst, @Alix-007, @aniruddhaadak80, @eleqtrizit, @yetval, @rvdlaar, @litang9, @machine3at, @miorbnli, @sallyom, @obviyus, @hugenshen, @cursoragent, @cxbAsDev, @wangmiao0668000666, @lsr911, and @jalfaro2876.
- **Delivery and runtime recovery:** outbound retry timing, channel lifecycle, abort handling, process I/O, and persisted state recovery now retain the correct operation outcome across expected failures. (#119942) Thanks @RomneyDa, @vincentkoc, @Pick-cat, @RileyJJY, @ZengWen-DT, @Monkey-wusky, @chengzhichao-xydt, @mushuiyu886, @masatohoshino, @moguangyu5-design, @sunlit-deng, @ZOOWH, @NianJiuZst, @Alix-007, @aniruddhaadak80, @eleqtrizit, @yetval, @rvdlaar, @litang9, @machine3at, @miorbnli, @sallyom, @obviyus, @hugenshen, @cursoragent, @cxbAsDev, @wangmiao0668000666, @lsr911, and @jalfaro2876.
- **Release packaging:** refresh the generated Plugin SDK API baseline so the published package preflight verifies the release surface. (#120163) Thanks @RomneyDa.

### Complete contribution record

This audited record covers the complete v2026.6.34..d7dbaf3bec8c3040edac1643f471bf8d18cb4d43 history: 166 merged PRs. The generation manifest also supplies direct commits as editorial input; the grouped notes above prioritize user impact.

releases.features:
- 增强 provider 和 channel 边界安全，限制不受信任的响应体，在昂贵操作前拒绝超大型输入
- 提升长运行任务可靠性，agent/gateway/retry/channel 路径现在能正确处理取消、重试、部分发送和流程失败
- 增强捆绑插件弹性，本地模型、浏览器、媒体和协作插件可从畸形负载、超时和瞬态故障中恢复
- 改进工具和工作区使用安全，浏览器自动化、本地工具、工作区读取等在主动 agent 运行前拒绝畸形或超大型输入
- 提升本地集成可靠性，本地模型发现、语音、会议和协作集成发出有界请求而不破坏网关
releases.bug_fixes:
- 修复响应和内存安全问题，provider/search/embedding/media/channel 集成在恶意负载耗尽内存前限制读取
- 修复交付和运行时恢复问题，出站重试时间、通道生命周期、中止处理、进程 I/O 和持久状态在预期故障中保持正确操作结果
